title: Comfort among the temporary arrangements

captions.physics: Making available space feel lived in

meaning: You can feel at home amid change, but shared footing needs comforts that do not have to be created afresh each time.
text: Even a temporary space can feel inhabited: you can cook dinner, find a place for a favourite cup and arrange comfortable lighting. The Empress in the physical position of Muladhara describes this care for the available present. The Wheel of Fortune in energy tests your footing through leaving routines to changing conditions, establishing nothing for long. The Fool in emotions welcomes a new beginning with lightness and interest. While you both enjoy experimenting, uncertainty can feel like freedom, yet dependable everyday arrangements may not keep pace with it.

For example, you eat at the table, move dinner to the sofa or set up a small table beside the window. Each version has its pleasures, while a box of essential cutlery keeps travelling after you. **Ease at home rests on things that need no new place every evening.** A settled corner does not remove spontaneity. It lets you change plans by choice while keeping a simple comfort you can return to without fresh preparation or another search.

The difficulty is treating any lasting arrangement as a limit on freedom. Even a small agreement is postponed in case tomorrow brings a different wish. Care increasingly goes into setting up the same things again, and misplaced objects start causing irritation. Novelty feels less enjoyable because each evening requires a fresh start. Shared footing emerges where freedom can rest on a few habits that work.
